messages:
jessica: Raj from Orion just asked for DPA + SCCs and a short DSAR/deletion SLA before we kick off their POC. they want scoped SIG answers for POC only. deadline: Tue COB.

raj: hi team, we need confirmation on deletion SLA (30 days), no-training clause, and subprocessors list to proceed with procurement.

mike: we can commit to 30-day deletion for user content in active storage and show an export endpoint. will note minor billing logs retained up to 90 days.

sara: i'll pull the subprocessors and a one-page security attestation (TLS, AES-256 at rest, KMS keys, RBAC). will highlight SOC2 and ISO where applicable.

amy-legal: we can add explicit language: "Redwood will not use Customer Data to train or improve models without prior written consent." we can sign SCC addendum scoped to POC.

jessica: great. Mike, can you draft a short example curl for export + a simple deletion config snippet we can show them?

mike: sure. export example: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/export -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '{"user_id":"u-123"}'`

mike: deletion snippet for docs: `storage.object_retention_days=30
model_cache.purge_on_user_delete=true`

raj: that looks good. also: will you confirm that customer data will not be used for training during the POC? we need that in writing.

amy-legal: confirmed. adding clause to DPA packet.

sara: uploaded subprocessors list and attestation to /shared/poc-orion/1795554325. sec-bot: created.

sec-bot: shared doc created at /shared/poc-orion/1795554325 by jessica

jessica: i'll bundle DPA + SCCs + attestation + export/delete examples and send to Raj Tue 09:00. flag me if you see any issues. :thumbsup:
